item.title: Ensemble Forecasting of ICU Resource Demand and Capacity Planning During the Delta Wave
item.description:
Overview A dynamic ensemble model aggregating various compartmental and statistical forecasts to accurately predict ICU bed utilization.

Problem Motivation During the height of pandemic surges, hospitals lacked reliable 14-day forecasts for critical care resource planning.

Methodology Developed a dynamic weighting algorithm that evaluated historical forecast errors of constituent models and dynamically adjusted their weights in a meta-ensemble.

Key Findings Reduced the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 14-day ICU census forecasts by 18% during peak surge periods.

item.title: Estimating the Impact of Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions on Viral Reproductive Rates
item.description:
Overview A rigorous causal evaluation of how various government-mandated lockdowns and mask mandates suppressed COVID-19 transmission dynamics.

Problem Motivation Policymakers required empirical evidence to balance the economic cost of NPIs against the public health benefits.

Methodology Applied a Bayesian structural time-series approach to estimate the counterfactual scenarios of disease spread absent specific interventions.

Key Findings Quantified the precise reduction in the effective reproduction number ($R_t$) attributable to specific non-pharmaceutical interventions.
